ns2:course.label: BFA Thesis Project
ns2:course.description: Creation of a culminating choreographic/performance project. 1 to 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours in separate terms. Prerequisite: DANC 362. Concurrent enrollment in DANC 498 required. Restricted to Senior standing in BFA Dance program.
